description: Gets a client's last logged load, best weight and reps, suggested next load and any coach-set target for given exercises. Use when the user asks what weight a client lifts, their personal bests, or what load to prescribe next. Not for session history (use list_client_sessions). Returns one row per exercise ID; the suggestion is empty when next-load suggestions are off for the team.

client_id.description: ID of the client (their user ID). Get it from list_clients (the "id" of each client), e.g. "64f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1".

exclude_session_id.description: Session to leave out of the last load, usually one still in progress. Get it from list_client_sessions.

exercise_ids.description: IDs of the exercises, 1 to 200, 24 hex characters each. Get them from list_team_exercises or get_client_session.

team_id.description: Team to act on. Omit to use the signed-in team.

name: get_client_exercise_performance
title: Get client exercise performance
